text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Mmmgh... Spark, my Umadol brain cells, 
spaaark...!
choice_data_list: You look pretty troubled, what's wrong?
You look pretty troubled, what's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Well, you see... I was wondering if 
there's any new kind of live that totally 
screams 'Falco!'"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
We gained even more fans at the Fan 
Appreciation Festival! I want to put on a 
concert that will make both our existing 
fans and new fans happy!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Still, sticking only to standard Umadol 
stuff feels a bit rut-ish, or... 
hnnngh...!
choice_data_list: Is there anything I can help with?
Is there anything I can help with?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Trainer did? ...In that case, I have a 
favor to ask!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Please produce Falco☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
You're always watching me, right? You 
might come up with a brand-new charm 
that's uniquely Falco!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I have no experience producing an idol, 
but... perhaps we might find a hint to 
solve this.
choice_data_list: Got it! I'll give it a try!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
First off, the concept for our next Live! 
What kind of direction should we go with, 
"Producer-san"?!
choice_data_list:
Because I really want to cheer everyone 
up—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
This is...! You mean, a cheerleader 
style!?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... But you know, I actually tried out 
this outfit at a previous live.
choice_data_list:
I see... Let's go with something else 
then!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
This time it's girly style! Sort of like a 
dreamy-cute idol, maybe?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Still, there's already a girl doing the 
dreamy-cute style. My gimmick might 
overlap with hers...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, although they explored various 
directions, they couldn't find anything 
that really clicked—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I think I might be... losing my way a 
little bit...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
No, I believe in you! I know that with you 
as my Trainer, you'll make me shine.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Because they're the one who supports Falco 
and tells me I deserve center stage more 
than anyone!☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A new charm to Smart Falcon... How can I 
bring that out during her live 
performances?
choice_data_list:
Come to think of it, is this where we 
first met?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She was dancing with a glittering smile. 
Even before meeting me, she gave her all 
to being an Umadol.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And she's still chasing her dream to this 
day. As her Trainer, seeing that makes me 
proud.

text_block_list.name: New Fan
text_block_list.text:
Falco's live is making my heart race... 
Whoa, it's starting...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Falco is aiming to be the undisputed 
center!"

text_block_list.name: New Fan
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Wait, is that a Tracen Academy 
uniform...? And I've never heard this song 
before...!?

text_block_list.name: Longtime Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"So nostalgic~! This is a really early 
song of theirs! Back then, we used to do 
live shows just like this!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Not yet! Falco's live show has only just 
begun~!

text_block_list.name: Longtime Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! A different costume this time...! And 
the song's a total live concert staple!

text_block_list.name: Longtime Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Was it around here that my fans started 
increasing...? Man, I was so happy back 
then...!

text_block_list.name: Longtime Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Ah, this is from the new racing outfit! 
The debut live performance was so 
exciting~!

text_block_list.name: New Fan
text_block_list.text:
You've done so many live shows to get 
here... Falco, you're amazing...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The charm of hers that I wanted to convey 
to the fans... was her fiery passion to 
become a top Umadol.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For new fans in the future, we can let 
them relive the emotional journey of her 
pursuing her dreams and growing—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And I wanted our existing fans to 
recognize it once again.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, everyone~! Falco was sparkling 
bright, wasn't she?☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I want to make everyone smile even more... 
That feeling hasn't changed, not in the 
past and not now.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Falco will keep on shining, now and 
foreeeever~!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Mmm...☆ That was the best concert ever! I 
can't believe how hyped the crowd was!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... That's all thanks to you, 
Trainer, you know?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"This live is something Trainer and I 
created together!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Fufu♪ With you and Falco together, 
Trainer, I know the two of us can reach 
even higher stages! ...Right, Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: "Take Falco to the dome! ...Just kidding♪"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I know! Maybe I'll have you produce my 
next live performance tooâ

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Because if it's you, Trainer, I know you 
can make Falco shine even more and more!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Later on, when I went to the Trainer's 
office—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Look, look, so many letters! I'm so glad 
everyone enjoyed it, hehe♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Later on, when I went to the Trainer's 
office—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"I'll keep cheering for Falco-san from now 
on", huh... Alright! Falco's gonna dash 
ahead at full speed!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
(Falco's the best! Falco's the best! 
Falco's the absolute beeeest!)

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, what a loud chant! Who knows, maybe 
this will become a legendary live show 
talked about for generations! Ehehe♪

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Falco's concert was so amazing. We 
definitely have to get tickets for the 
next one too!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Looks like everyone's still totally hyped 
up! It really was an amazing concert, 
after all♪
